step_2.raw_requirement: As a registered user, I want to login to ParaBank and view my account overview

bdd_scenarios.scenario: User logs in and views account overview
bdd_scenarios.given: I am a registered user on ParaBank homepage
bdd_scenarios.when: I enter valid credentials and submit login form
bdd_scenarios.then: I should be logged in and see my account overview page

test_scenarios.name: test_registered_user_logs_in_and_views_account_overview
test_scenarios.given: I am on the ParaBank login page
when: I enter valid credentials and submit
then: I should see my account overview page with account details
